title: Caching notes
text: Cache-aside loads data into cache on a miss. Write-through updates cache and database together. Write-back writes to cache first and flushes later. Invalidation strategies matter for consistency.

title: Reliability notes
text: Use timeouts, retries with jitter, and circuit breakers. Make payment APIs idempotent using idempotency keys. Prefer graceful degradation over cascading failure.
